summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Workshop - CLO X UE Integration Process ## Introduction This video will explain how to use the LiveSync plugin to easily connect CLO with Unreal Engine (UE). ## Downloading Unreal Engine (UE) 1. **Search for Epic**: Go to the Epic official website. 2. **Log In**: Click to log in. If you don't have an Epic account, you need to register using an email. 3. **Access Virtual Machine**: After logging in, click the upper left corner to find the virtual machine, then click to download the program. 4. **Installation Method**: If you have questions about the installation method, you can view the official recording of the UE installation method tutorial. ### Installation Requirements - **Windows System**: Check the installation graphics card and processor requirements. - **Mac Requirements**: Verify the requirements for Mac computers. ## Installing Unreal Engine (UE) 1. After downloading the program, go to the download folder and find the Epic Games installer. 2. **Installation Path**: Double-click to open it. You can install the program on a non-C drive to save space. 3. **Confirm Installation Location**: Navigate to a folder and click to confirm. The Epic Games program will then appear on your desktop. 4. **Log In**: After installation, log in to your Epic account. This account should match the Epic Games account registered on the Epic official website. ### Adding the Engine 1. **Access the Engine Interface**: After logging in, you will see your account information and can enter the virtual engine. 2. **Select Engine Version**: Locate the version of the engine you wish to add. Click to install or add the engine. ## Installing LiveSync Plugin ### For UE 5.6.1 1. **Installation Location**: Set the installation location of the engine, ensuring there are no Chinese or special characters in the path. 2. **Install Process**: Click to install. The installation process may take some time. You can install multiple versions of UE by clicking to add. ### Downloading LiveSync Plugin 1. **Access Connect Business**: Download CLO's LiveSync plugin by searching for it. 2. **Select Version**: Choose the corresponding version starting from 2.0.1 LiveSync. 3. **Add to Library**: After entering your library, check in the launcher to see the LiveSync plugin of CLO MD. ### Install LiveSync 1. **Installation Slot**: Click to install the engine, noting that the slot for adding the plugin is for version 5.6. 2. **Installation Confirmation**: Confirm installation; it may take some time. ### Installing Additional Plugins 1. **Search for Substance Plugin**: In FAB, search for the Substance plugin and proceed to install it similarly to LiveSync. 2. **Installation for UE 5.5**: The same method applies if you need to install LiveSync for UE 5.5. ## Setting Up Unreal Engine 1. **Project Creation**: Create a new project in UE, ensuring the project name is in English without special characters. 2. **Plugin Configuration**: After creating the project, configure the plugins. Search for CLO’s plugin and Substance plugin, ensuring they are both enabled. 3. **Project Settings**: Adjust other project settings as necessary, including translucent options and X11 settings. ## Importing CLO Data into UE 1. **Import Settings**: Ensure CLO is in simulation mode or UV editing mode before importing clothing data. 2. **Select Import Options**: Choose the appropriate options for importing clothing, including garment simulation data and animation data if applicable. 3. **Finalize Import**: After selecting the desired options, click "Update" to import the model and clothing into UE. ## Saving and Managing Project Files 1. **File Management**: Organize imported files into folders and adjust their properties as needed. 2. **Animation Setup**: Drag the imported animation sequence into the appropriate position and reset values to default. ## Finalizing the Scene 1. **Scene Arrangement**: Arrange the model and costume files within the scene, adjusting their positions and sizes as necessary. 2. **Running the Animation**: Use the play function to view the animation in the UE window. 3. **Screenshot Functionality**: Use the high-resolution screenshot feature to capture the desired scene. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching this tutorial. We hope you found it informative, and we look forward to seeing you in the next video! ```
